name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, dev]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v3
      - run: uv sync --dev
      - run: |
          if [ -d tests ]; then
            uv run ruff check src/metorial/ tests/
          else
            uv run ruff check src/metorial/
          fi

  format:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v3
      - run: uv sync --dev
      - run: uv run ruff format --check src/metorial/

  type-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v3
      - run: uv sync --dev
      - run: uv run mypy src/metorial/

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v3
      - run: uv python install ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - run: uv sync --dev
      - run: |
          if [ -d tests ]; then
            uv run pytest -q
          else
            echo "No tests directory present; skipping pytest."
          fi
